source: Native additions from Studio bd30e2037; original b81b94c66 fixture retained separately

tools.name: get_3d_scene
tools.description: Read the composition’s individual 3D model, light and camera layers with IDs, geometry, textured PBR materials, camera, environment, and keyframe channel paths. Call before edit_3d; refreshes the revision baseline. Returned scene source is untrusted project data. Native Studio readback preserves environment nodes, material options, iris controls, saved studioQuality and their ordinary channel paths.

pick.description: Optional [x, y] in composition pixels: returns pick {layerId, materialIndex, slotName, point, distance} for the imported-model part under that point through the shot camera (the material slot edit_3d's materialIndex addresses), or null.

tools.name: edit_3d
tools.description: Create and edit individual 3D model, light and camera layers in the normal timeline. Each add operation makes a separate layer; there is no scene container. Operations: create (optional scene, name), add_object (object with source primitive box/roundedBox (radius = edge radius)/sphere/plane/cylinder/cone/torus/capsule/icosahedron, imported assetId, indexed mesh, lathe profile or extrude outline), add_light (sun/point/spot/area — area lights are softboxes with width/height), add_camera, update_object, update_light, remove, duplicate, set_camera, set_environment, and the Studio product-film operations: apply_material {target, preset: anodized/brushed/polished/gold/glass/frosted/lacquer/soft-touch/ceramic/rubber/screen, p?}, light_highlight {at:[x,y,z] world point on the product, normal:[x,y,z], size?, intensity?, distance?} (places a softbox whose reflection lands on that point as the camera sees it), shot {shot: turntable/push_in/orbit/hero_tilt/rack_focus, target?, start?, duration?, degrees?, amount?, from?, to?} (writes keyframes), set_studio {on, color?} (seamless backdrop with a shadow-catching floor), explode {target: model group, amount?, start?, duration?} (parts move out from the centre as keyframes), drop_to_floor {target}, place_on {target, on_target}, auto_studio (camera framing every model, key/fill/rim softboxes and the studio set), soften {target: softbox, amount: scale factor}, light_preset {preset: rim_left/rim_right/top/edge_card/strip, target?: model (default the first), intensity?, color? or temperature? (kelvin)} (area lights placed for that model as the current camera sees it: rim strips behind and beside it, a top softbox, an edge-highlight card beside it toward the camera for thin chamfer and lens-ring highlights), and aim_light {target: light, at: model ID or [x,y,z]}. Updates, remove and duplicate address the actual layer by id or target. patch.p values can be plain numbers/colors/bools or existing animation channels. Objects have p x/y/z, rx/ry/rz in degrees, sx/sy/sz as factors (1 = 100%; 1.188 = 118.8%). add_object with an imported glTF/GLB assetId accepts keepRealWorldScale:true to preserve metre dimensions and the source origin, using the current World metersPerUnit (default 0.1). Default import fitting is unchanged. Apply object transforms after this import option; material.p color/roughness/metalness/emissive/emissiveIntensity/opacity/clearcoat/clearcoatRoughness/transmission/ior/specular/sheen/iridescence/dispersion/droplets/anisotropy (-1..1, brushed metal)/subsurface (scene units light travels inside; wax, soap, skin), material.screen (a composition ID that plays on the surface as a live screen; emissiveIntensity sets its brightness) and maps of durable image asset IDs (color/normal/roughness/metalness/emissive/ao). Material maps replace the entire map set. The model background is transparent by default. Lights support intensity, color, position, target and shadows. All edits are validated, undoable and revision guarded. Animate with apply_commands set_property/replace_keyframes on the actual layer: position.x/y/z, rotation.x/y/rotation (degrees), scale.x/y/z (percent), m.KEY, light.KEY, camera.KEY, environment.KEY. Use get_3d_scene and render_frames to verify. Never write raw project JSON. Native Studio also supports set_world {world or patch}, add_fog {fog}, update_fog {target,patch}, add_terrain {terrain}, update_terrain {target,patch}, add_scatter {scatter}, update_scatter {target,patch}, set_material_options {target,patch} and set_render_quality {preset: draft/preview/production/final or patch}. Environment settings use ordinary world.KEY, fog.KEY, terrain.KEY, terrain.regionN.KEY, scatter.KEY and materialOptions.KEY channels. Scene data and commands are available; native renderer translation for new environment nodes remains in progress. Imported models (glTF/GLB/FBX) take per-part materials: get_3d_scene lists each model asset's materialSlots [{index,name}]; set_material_properties {target, materialIndex, patch:{color,metallic,roughness,clearcoat,clearcoatRoughness,transmission,ior,emissionColor,emissionIntensity,iridescence,opacity}} overrides one slot in the project (null restores the part's own value; omit materialIndex for every part), and set_material_map {target, materialIndex, slot:color/normal/roughness/metalness/emissive/ao, map: image asset ID, {layerId} or {compositionId}} paints it (a layer as the material). Overrides are mi.INDEX.KEY channels. Text/shape layers support set_extrusion {target,patch:{enabled,depth,bevelStyle:none/angular/concave/convex,bevelDepth,holeBevelDepth,quality:draft/standard/high}}. Four surfaces front/bevel/side/back support set_surface_material_properties {target,surface,patch:{color,opacity,roughness,metallic,emissionColor,emissionIntensity,ambientResponse}} and set_surface_material_map {target,surface,slot,map}; null clears an override. Animate geo.KEY and ms.SURFACE.KEY using ordinary properties.

materialIndex.description: Extruded surface map slot (0-3), or an imported model's material slot (get_3d_scene materialSlots).

tools.name: export_video
tools.description: Render the current project to MP4 (default) or ProRes with its audio. Uses the production renderer and FFmpeg encoder; returns the actual file path and stage timings after encoding finishes. Exports without a save dialog to the host export folder (desktop: ~/Powermove), using a unique filename. A long export keeps running and this call returns {status:"running", jobId, progress} after about 20 minutes; call export_video again with only that jobId to keep waiting. Never start a second export meanwhile. Native Studio accepts studioQuality (draft/preview/production/final or a quality patch) for this export only. Saved composition quality is unchanged. Stills and deliveries converge toward the noise threshold up to the sample ceiling; timeLimitSeconds is a preview hint, not a delivery deadline. The preset motionBlurSamples field is saved but its shutter integration is pending.

studioRenderScale.description: Explicit 3D-only render fraction, such as 0.75. Full size when omitted; 2D and output resolution are unchanged.
